g.text: Six completed continuation fits · actual epoch histories
Continuation from project V2 initializers; 62 completed epochs across six fits. CE + contrastive adds 0.1 × contrastive loss.
Objective values therefore have different definitions. Circles mark each run's development-selected epoch; test did not select weights.
The development-selected candidate later failed the human UNKNOWN test guard and was not promoted.
